nom: Good Molecules Firming Peptide Eye Cream

avis.titre: I will not buy this again
avis.texte: I've been using it for 2 weeks now and I see no change my under eye I still have dark circles puffyness.

avis.titre: gentle, easy to use, not bad results
avis.texte: I switched from the yerba mate eye cream by good molecules to this, and I love it even more than the yerba mate. It's gentle, easy to use, and it makes my undereyes look brighter. I don't know if I notice much else because it's only been about a week, but it's a good, affordable eye cream!
Works wonders. I use it once a day, because twice is too much. Sometimes it makes my eyes just water for no reason or when there is a breeze it waters more but I love it!

avis.titre: Really helping my undereyes look more even!
avis.texte: Loving what this cream is doing for the skin around my eyes. Hydrating and nonclogging for my sensitive skin. I've noticed my veins and wrinkles have been less pronounced since using it.
Gave me an allergic reaction. Tube is not great as well. You barely press snd so much of the eye cream comes out not well functioning.

I would not say I have sensitive skin. However, the morning after I used this product for the first time I woke up with swollen skin around my eyes. I used this product again weeks later, wanting to give it another try. The next morning, the skin around my eyes was very swollen, red, and itchy. I used this product on a Saturday - it is Wednesday and my skin is still red and irritated. I would avoid if you have sensitive skin.
I have tried a lot of products for the bags under my eyes. Thanks to this cream I've gone from garbage bags go ziplock bags!
I have eye bags and these like eye lines, I applied some of this last night and i see improvement already

Ive been using this for about 2 weeks and notice a huge difference with my dark circles. I finally dont need concealer under my eyes. I still have some fine lines under my eyes but i havent been consistent. Excited to see what its like over time and consistency
Im so happy this amazing brand came put with a new eye cream! I absolutely love it , i use it every day and night. Highly recommend ans great for the cost.

It's been almost two weeks since I brought this product and can say that it works pretty good. There's a noticeable difference in the fine lines under my eyes. Lightweight, doesn't feel sticky, and very hydrating.
I have tried this brand before and for some reason this product gave me a terrible allergic reaction. Extreme dryness and redness. Be careful with this product.

I've been using this eye cream for about two weeks, and I'm honestly impressed. I've already noticed a visible improvement in the fine lines around my eyes. It feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and keeps the area hydrated. I'm excited to see the results with continued use!

I've been using this eye cream for about two weeks, and I'm honestly impressed. I've already noticed a visible improvement in the fine lines around my eyes. It feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and keeps the area hydrated. I'm excited to see the results with continued use!

If you like the yerba mate eye gel, you'll love this! Most eye creams with actives burn my skin but this one is so gentle and hydrating. I've already noticed a bit of brightening after just a week of use!
